title: Tom and His Sports
text:
Tom likes football. He plays football with his friends on Saturday. They play in the park near his house. Tom is a good player.

Tom also likes swimming. He goes to the pool on Sunday morning. His sister swims with him. After swimming, they eat ice cream.

questions.text: What sport does Tom play with his friends?
Why does Tom probably enjoy sports?
options: He does not like his friends

questions.text: How do Tom and his sister probably feel after swimming?

a place with water where people swim

paragraph_translations: Tom gosta de futebol. Ele joga futebol com os amigos aos sábados. Eles jogam no parque perto da casa dele. Tom é um bom jogador.
Tom também gosta de natação. Ele vai à piscina no domingo de manhã. A irmã dele nada com ele. Depois de nadar, eles comem sorvete.
